**Final trace IDs:** `trace_001` (small cabinet room, R21 area) and `trace_002` (larger two-table room, R06 area) — trace_002 selected last.

**Frame:** origin at SW exterior corner, +x east, +y north. Calibrated with x-anchors [pixel 248→0m, pixel 612→10m] (building outer E/W faces) and y-anchors [pixel 880→0m, pixel 150→20m] (outer S/N faces), giving ~36.4 px/m, derived from the 10000mm top/bottom and 20000mm side overall dimension chains.

**Shared wall between the two rooms:** horizontal wall band at pixel y≈367–373 (world y≈13.97 m), visible as a double gray/white line running x≈450→605 in the crops — used as the small room's south edge / two-table room's north edge (trace_001 V3-V4 edge ≡ trace_002 V1-V2 edge).

**Two-table room's south wall:** horizontal wall at pixel y≈595 (world y≈7.81 m), visible below the second table group, before the next room to the south begins (not independently verified against that further room, since it was out of scope).

**Two corridor doors (west wall, x-pixel≈450, world x≈5.55 m):**
- Small room door: jambs at pixel y 300/330 (world y≈15.89/15.07 m) — swing arc origin at ~(455,298) curving toward the corridor; jambs picked at wall face, not leaf tip.
- Two-table room door: jambs at pixel y 400/430 (world y≈13.15/12.33 m) — corresponding arc visible entering from corridor; again jamb points used, arc kept as swing evidence only, not a corner.

**Uncertainty:** East exterior wall outer face taken at pixel x≈605–610 (window strips visible along it in both rooms, included in crops) but not independently re-verified against the right-hand dimension chain in this pass; two-table room's south wall boundary is based on a single visual read and not cross-checked with the room further south — flagged as unconfirmed given remaining time. Door jamb widths (≈30 px ≈ 0.8 m) are approximate, read directly off the arcs rather than an explicit door-width label.
